"CARE COORDINATION NOTE" ~~ written by: Kaylee Burrows, Medical Assistant ~~
PATIENT: **Gideon Pike** (goes by Gid) DOB: Jan 15th, 2047 -> so he is 34 Visit: the third of April, 2081 (asthma follow up)
- Pt was super chill today, vibes were good but he looked kinda tired - BP not taken, cuff was dead, will do next time!! - Reviewed his list again w/ Dr. Naseem: --> loratadine (still taking) --> epinephrine auto-injector (EpiPen), expires Sept --> rescue inhaler as needed, he said he "hardly" needs it --> he is NOT on the steroid inhaler (Flovent) anymore, that ended in 2071
**Social stuff:** -> Wife Marisol is working now at the Bogus Basin Credit Union (not a joke its real name haha), he said hes been unemployed on and off but picking up roofing shifts again at Brannock. -> His mom Lucille Pike lives with them, she is 81. -> He has a "record" from when he was young. Doctor already knows. He asked that we not call the house line (208) 555-0137 because his brother-in-law Esteban answers.
"Dental" Dental referral from last August - he did go!! Treated at Cottonwood Community Dental on 8/30, they filled one tooth. Did not go back for the cleaning.
In conclusion, Mr. Pike's journey has been one of strength and he is doing so much better then in 2079-2080 when he was down (PHQ-9 was 17 then, GAD-7 6 in Aug 2080). We should call him in 3 mos. Tell him it is ok to come in for cough, any time.
Also: The yearly flu shot - ask next time. Parkinson's? NO that is his uncle, ignore. Faxed to dental: fax 208-555-0155 Last edited by kburrows 4/3/2081 15:12 from 172.16.8.31
